observations: 12 distinct names map to the corresponding historical source identities; no five-element hero substitutions.

Guan Yu uses a tall portrait to preserve the recognisable long beard; 128px avatar approximate face width37.4px, not normalized to the other faces.
Sun Quan and Zhao Yun retain original tight margins; transparent card padding does not regenerate missing source detail.
